features.name: ocean_route
features.label: Route region
features.qualification: A regional category does not measure vessel exposure or route geometry.

features.name: operator_type
features.label: Operator category
features.qualification: Owner class does not establish maintenance quality or response time.

features.name: chokepoint
features.label: Chokepoint corridor
features.qualification: A corridor label does not locate a break or quantify anchoring activity.

features.name: age_years
features.label: Cable age
features.qualification: Age changes annually; it does not certify wear, condition, or remaining life.

features.name: fiber_pairs
features.label: Fiber pairs
features.qualification: Pair count describes configuration, not fault tolerance by itself.

features.name: length_km
features.label: Cable length
features.qualification: Total length does not provide seabed conditions or per-kilometer failure exposure.

features.name: n_landing_countries
features.label: Landing-country count
features.qualification: Country count is not a landing-station inventory or dependency map.

features.name: design_capacity_tbps
features.label: Design capacity
features.qualification: Design potential differs from activated capacity and carried traffic.

features.name: lit_capacity_tbps
features.label: Activated capacity
features.qualification: Activated capacity is not measured traffic; it also depends on infrastructure.

features.name: utilization_pct
features.label: Capacity utilization
features.qualification: No traffic telemetry or verified denominator is supplied.

features.name: protected_burial
features.label: Burial/armor flag
features.qualification: A binary flag does not measure burial depth, protected extent, or verified protection quality.

features.name: route_redundancy
features.label: Route cable count
features.qualification: Other cables on a route do not establish independent paths or spare restoration capacity.

features.name: fault_this_year
features.label: Current-year fault
features.description: Prior experience at the prediction cutoff
features.qualification: Available only after the current year closes; cause and repair condition remain unknown.

decision_rule: Saved classes [0,1]; argmax of predict_proba. Ties map to class 0, as in sklearn predict. No threshold adjustment.
